text: ok so click on a piece. click paint target. [Image #1] ok i painted this. from here i click on what? apply paint?
resolution: Explained the building paint-target workflow. After painting from a building face target, the correct next action is Apply paint, which materializes the current painted mask into a custom material and assigns that material id to the selected wall/floor face target. Save to library only stores an editable painter document and does not apply it to building skins. No code changed.
